syncEngine.notes: Exact pin on the reviewed 6.16 minor line. No caret/tilde and no launch-time npx.

hostRuntime.bundledNodePolicy: Use Electron's embedded Node via ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE for the owned sync child. Launch must not require a global Node or floating npx.

setupToolchain.scope: Private per-userData toolchain created by guided Linux x64 setup. Does not mutate the system Node install or shell profile.

git.notes: Installer dependency (deb Depends: git). Setup refuses to continue without an absolute /usr path executable.

rejectedAdapters.reason: Pins hq-cloud major 5; incompatible with the reviewed 6.16 sync engine line used by this companion.
Declares hq-cloud ^5.1.0; cannot share one compatible sync engine with @indigoai-us/hq-cloud@6.16.35.

linux.notes: Owned ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE child with private IPC stop + lock release; unit SyncSupervisor stop ownership; scripts/verify-sync-child.mjs packaged probe. Workspace registry persists root/environment/installationId atomically with alias + dual-ownership checks (tests/native/workspaces.test.ts). Credential lifecycle: PKCE loopback + Cognito verify, OS safeStorage with basic_text fail-closed, desktop account.encrypted isolated from ~/.hq/cognito-tokens.json, sign-out clears owned credentials without deleting workspace files (tests/native/auth.test.ts). Guided setup journal + crash recovery (setup-state.ts / tests/native/setup.test.ts); membership discovery keeps explicit retry state and opens hq.computer create/invite web flows with focus-return refresh. US-012: shared hq-sync-runner argv (--watch/--direction both/--event-push + explicit scope), NDJSON protocol reduce, exclusive desktop-sync lock, bounded restart/backoff, pause/resume + IPC stop that preserves HQ_STATE_DIR journals (src/main/sync/*, tests/unit/sync-supervisor.test.ts, tests/runtime/supervisor.test.ts). US-013: Sync screen + status expose reconciliation/pending/realtime/polling/offline/paused/last confirmed sync from runner events; pause/resume/retry + validated scope controls; conflict list keep/publish-local/overwrite/abort with default abort (src/renderer/screens/sync.tsx, sync-status.tsx, conflict-list.tsx, tests/e2e/sync.spec.ts). US-016: Settings diagnostics show app/runtime versions, workspace environment, sync outcomes, and health probe results; support export requires redacted preview before save with synthetic secret/path markers stripped (src/main/diagnostics.ts, settings.tsx, tests/native/diagnostics.test.ts); narrowly scoped Repair restores owned userData toolchain only and fingerprints workspace roots to prove no content mutation; missing vs failed runtime diagnoses stay distinct with retry guidance. US-017: tray lifecycle + opt-in start-at-login via TrayController / autostart / lifecycle modules (src/main/tray.ts, autostart.ts, lifecycle.ts, tests/native/background.test.ts); close-to-tray keeps sync with discoverable Open/Pause/Quit tray menu while Quit runs ShutdownGate to stop owned watchers; Linux XDG autostart is per-user, idempotent, and AppImage-aware; no-tray hosts stay window-required with Settings disabled; WSL enablement is refused with visible guidance (no invisible failed startup loop). Authenticated live subscribe/exchange and authenticated two-client conflict convergence remain deferred to user OAuth desktop acceptance — fixture/unit evidence covers the UI contract without claiming a live cloud round trip. US-022: shared client-health contract/reporter/state under src/main/health/ with attribution hq-desktop-os, environment-isolated install id + monotonic sequence, startup/5-minute/debounced heartbeat scheduler, bounded local-file facts, and HTTP transport default OFF unless HQ_CLIENT_HEALTH_REPORTING=1 + auth (tests/native/client-health.test.ts, __tests__/stories/US-022.test.ts). Live support-view heartbeats on Windows11/Ubuntu24.04/WSL2 and upstream mapping remain deferred — prd.passes stays false.

windows.notes: Native Windows host matrix remains outstanding (including Windows Credential Manager / DPAPI acceptance, Windows guided setup, Windows sync supervisor, sync controls UI acceptance, diagnostics/repair acceptance, and tray/login-item acceptance); prepare-runtime records the gap without blocking Linux acceptance. US-022 client-health live support-view proof on Windows 11 x64 remains deferred.

wsl2.notes: WSL discovery module returns actionable unavailable/missing/stopped states and rejects WSL1 via injectable parser tests. Live Windows WSL2 picker + runtime ownership remain US-014; not claimed from Linux fixtures. Auth handoff into a distro is US-014. Diagnostics/repair on WSL remain deferred with US-014. Start-at-login inside WSL is refused with visible guidance (bounded; no invisible failed loop); full WSL host startup acceptance stays deferred. US-022 WSL2 health identity isolation is unit-covered; live support-view proof remains deferred.
